## Types (19)

```text
type BooleanColumn<TRow> = BaseColumn<TRow> & {…}
  type: "boolean"
type ColumnAlign = "left" | "center" | "right"
type ColumnDef<TRow> = StringColumn<TRow> | NumberColumn<TRow> | DateColumn<TRow> | BooleanColumn<TRow> | EnumColumn<TRow>
type ColumnVisibility = Record<string, boolean>
type DataSource<TRow> = { mode: "client"; data: TRow[] } | { mode: "server"; data: TRow[]; rowCount: number; loading?: boolean; onStateChange: (state: GridState) => void }
type DateColumn<TRow> = BaseColumn<TRow> & {…}
  type: "date" | "datetime"
type EnumColumn<TRow> = BaseColumn<TRow> & {…}
  options: EnumOption[]
  type: "enum"
type EnumFilterOption = EnumOption & {…}
  count?: number
```
